headline: FULA Network Surges to 900 Nodes Amid DePIN Storage Boom
subtitle: Functionland's community-driven expansion puts it on a credible growth trajectory as decentralized storage demand accelerates in 2026.
briefing:
Functionland's FULA Network has reached 900 active nodes, a milestone that reflects meaningful infrastructure expansion for a project building a community-owned alternative to centralized cloud storage. <cite index="10-1,10-2">Functionland positions itself as a decentralized cloud alternative, providing secure and encrypted storage through its Fula Network</cite> — and the node count growth signals that its hardware-first model is gaining traction on the ground.

The timing is favorable. <cite index="6-7">By early 2026, DePIN's combined market capitalization sits in the $9–10 billion range, larger than the oracles sector, while generating tens of millions in monthly on-chain revenue from actual services people pay for.</cite> <cite index="3-15,3-16">DePIN sits between AI demand and Web3 infrastructure — if compute, storage, and decentralized data services keep growing, useful projects stand to benefit.</cite>

Functionland's product layer is also maturing at a well-timed moment. The FxFiles MCP integration — which grants AI assistants scoped, read-write access to a single folder with no deletion rights — speaks directly to a growing security concern. <cite index="20-5,20-6">Wiz Research found MCP servers in at least 80% of observed cloud environments in early 2026, and MCP has consolidated into a de facto standard faster than agent frameworks have.</cite> Functionland's permission-constrained design offers a principled answer to that exposure. Meanwhile, <cite index="11-1,11-2">the team's roadmap targets migrating larger organizations' data from traditional cloud to the Fula ecosystem in Q2 2026, followed by an open-source monetization plan for developers and influencers in Q3.</cite>

Watch for whether the node count continues compounding and whether the Q3 monetization roadmap produces tangible developer adoption.
